template_data.headline_html: Four things that silently lock your GSA rates.

items.title: Basis of Award
items.desc: Tied to your best commercial rate — define it wrong and you carry that discount for the contract's life.

items.title: Price reduction clause
items.desc: Lower your commercial price post-award and GSA rates drop automatically. Most don't know this exists.

items.title: Labor category precision
items.desc: Vague SIN descriptions mean agencies can't find you in search. Visibility lives in the definition.

items.title: Pre-submission benchmarking
items.desc: Know what approved vendors in your SIN charge before you submit. Pricing blind is pricing out.
